equations_read_from_published_equation_i.note: The article's equation graphic was fetched and read; the derivation assumes spatially constant consumption for the closed form used here.
equations_read_from_published_equation_i.role: steady spherical diffusion-consumption equation in the paper's radial coordinate

equations_read_from_published_equation_i.conversion: The paper defines oxygen content C0 from boundary partial pressure p0 through its conversion factor Omega; substituting C0 = p0/Omega gives r_l = sqrt(6 D C0/a).

local_code.interpretation: The existing repository profile is algebraically consistent with the source equation and boundary assumptions. Existing comments called the formula derived rather than transcribed; source review confirms the spherical limit expression is explicitly printed as Eq. 2.6 after the paper's content/pressure conversion. The profile solution remains an application of Eq. 2.2 and its boundary conditions.
local_code.slab: No slab expression is attributed to Grimes. The 2 coefficient is separately derived from D C'' = a with a no-flux center and C(L)=C0.

primary_source.citation: Grimes DR, Kelly C, Bloch K, Partridge M. A method for estimating the oxygen consumption rate in multicellular tumour spheroids. Journal of the Royal Society Interface. 2014;11(92):20131124.

source_content_context.consumption: a = 7.29 +/- 1.4e-7 m^3 O2 kg^-1 s^-1 reported/fitted for spheroids studied
source_content_context.diffusion_coefficient: D = 2e-9 m^2/s assumed close to water in this study
source_content_context.diffusion_limit: r_l = 232 +/- 22 um reported for the spheroids studied
source_content_context.reuse_policy: These tumour-specific values and validation do not transfer to a Xenobot-inspired microcarrier or epithelial repair patch.

retrieval_notes: Europe PMC served the article's open-access XML; its display equation bodies are JPEG equation images, so the displayed images were fetched and read separately.
The equation-image bytes are identified by the exact URL and SHA-256 above; the full article is not copied into this repository.
The source paper's experiment and parameter values are recorded only to delimit the original context, not used in either reuse example.
